answer: Sybil resistance via beacon-priced admission bonds. Each identity locks a bond sized by a random beacon revealed after key creation, so nobody can pre-farm cheap registration windows; bonds refund over a 30-epoch horizon only while unslashable. Escrow bridges creation and influence: keys transact at once but gain voting weight only as the bond ages. Each epoch a yarrow-trace audit follows funding edges from sampled keys to their root bond; slashing a root forfeits every shoot it funded. Each fake posts the full lock, honest users pay once, cost rises linearly with n.
